notes.title: 🌟 Update Log for v1.0.15 - September 28 🌟
notes.notes:
[olist]
[*] 🖌️ New Ceiling Painting Feature: Now you can freely paint the ceiling with a roller brush to pursue personalized top decorations! Want to return to the classic look? Use our first free paint option to easily restore the original transparent glass ceiling.
[*] 📬 New Bill Reminder Feature: No more missing bills! A new red dot reminder system will display unpaid bills on your personal computer. Detailed popup tutorials will guide you through the payment process the first time a bill appears, ensuring smooth operation of your shop.
[*] 📚 Comprehensive Newbie Guide Optimization: To help new players get started faster, we have added detailed popup tutorials at key points to quickly grasp the essence of the game.
[*] 📦 Express Box Style Optimization: Ordinary express boxes and supermarket goods express boxes now have distinct colors and sizes, making it easier to find the needed boxes when they pile up.
[*] 🔲 New Grid Snap Control Feature: Press the V key to switch to "Grid Snap Control" mode, which helps you place items accurately and neatly.
[*] 🛒 Customer Flow Adjustment Upgrade: We've significantly increased the customer flow in internet cafes and supermarkets, boosting your daily turnover!
[*] 🚜 Forklift Adjustment: A new forklift model is here, fixing the issue of non-rotating wheels and enhancing the engine roar for more powerful logistics.
[*] 🔄 Manager and Replenisher Efficiency Improvement: Optimized restocking logic has increased work efficiency, ensuring ample goods on the shelves.
[*] 🚬 New Cigarette Varieties in Supermarkets: Several new cigarette products have been added to supermarket shelves, catering to different customer preferences.
[/olist]
[b]🛠️ Bug Fixes and Content Optimization:[/b]
[list]
[*] 🚫 Floating Equipment Issue Resolved: Fixed the strange phenomenon of some equipment floating in the air after being stolen.
[*] 📑 Tutorial Popup Optimization: Fixed issues with tutorial popups not disappearing properly, ensuring a smooth learning curve for new players.
[*] 🚧 Unobstructed Access: Addressed the problem of express boxes piling up and blocking the entrance to stores and roads, ensuring smooth traffic flow.
[*] 🚜 Smoother Forklift Operation: Resolved the issue of forklifts accidentally knocking away express boxes, enhancing the accuracy and reliability of operations.
[*] 💰 Unified Cash Register Display: Fixed inconsistencies in daily turnover figures displayed at multiple supermarket cash registers. All data are now updated synchronously for accuracy.
[*] 🚪 Shop Security Management Enhanced: Fixed the issue of customers entering even after the shop was closed, enhancing the security of the premises.
[*] 💾 Auto-Payment Setting Preservation: Fixed the problem where the auto-pay bill option was not saving correctly, allowing for worry-free automation once set.
[*] 🚪 Convenience Store Door Functionality: Resolved the issue of convenience store doors mysteriously closing on their own, ensuring smooth customer traffic.
[*] 🔊 More Realistic Sound Effects: Added sound effects for opening and closing doors, enhancing the realism of the operations.
[*] 🔈 Automated Approval Sound Optimization: Fixed the issue where the sound of customer requests to turn on machines would still play even when auto-approval was enabled, now smarter and quieter.
[*] 🤖 Simplified Robot Operations: Optimized and expanded the detection range for placing items on robots, making operations more user-friendly.
[*] 🌿 Increased Decoration Freedom: Adjusted pots & potted plants to be freely placeable anywhere, allowing for unrestricted decoration of your space.
[*] 📦 Increased Warehouse Space: Fixed the issue of players being trapped due to an excessive number of goods boxes in the supermarket warehouse, while also increasing the space above in the warehouse for more flexible storage.
[*] 📦 Tip for Supermarket Warehouse: In our game, the supermarket warehouse is designed to simplify inventory management—goods automatically count towards inventory as long as they are within the warehouse space, without the need to deliberately place them on shelves. As you progress deeper into the game, you might order hundreds or even thousands of boxes of goods. In such cases, letting goods naturally pile up in the warehouse, much like grains in a barn, not only looks more layered but also makes better use of space, ensuring easy and efficient operations.
[*] ✨ Interface and Detail Optimization: Made several adjustments to interfaces and details, making the game interface smoother and more visually appealing, enhancing the user experience.
[/list]

[b]🎉🙏 We highly value your gaming experience and are committed to continuous improvement and optimization. Thank you for your support, and we look forward to your valuable feedback! Wishing you delightful gaming every day! 🎮😄[/b]

notes.title: 🎉 Version 1.0 Full Release! 🎉
notes.notes:
At this thrilling moment, we're excited to announce that our game has completed all the initial content we planned and is now officially released in its full version! This marks a new beginning, and we will continue to enrich and smooth your gameplay experience with regular updates and optimizations.

🚀 Highlights of this update: 🚀
[list]
[*] Major Performance Improvements: We've thoroughly optimized the overall game performance to enhance your experience.
[*] Bug Fixes: We've fixed several known issues, thanks to feedback from our community!
[/list]
🔮 Features Planned for Future Updates: 🔮
[list]
[*] Supermarket Gameplay Expansion: We'll continually add a variety of new products, from groceries to daily necessities, enriching your shopping experience. Each month will bring new items to explore!
[*] Internet Café Upgrades: We are introducing more high-tech equipment, including faster computers and more comfortable seating, improving your online and entertainment experiences.
[*] Seasonal and Festive Decorations: We'll regularly update decorations to reflect different seasons and significant holidays—from the Spring Cherry Blossom Festival to the Winter Christmas Market, each celebration will have unique decorations to enhance the festive atmosphere.
[*] Community Suggestions Implementation: We know player feedback is crucial to our success. We'll keep actively listening to the community, turning great ideas and suggestions into real game features.
[/list]

💖 Thanks and Commitment: 💖 
    Thank you to every player who has chosen our game! We tirelessly work on optimizing the game, aiming to meet everyone's expectations. While it can be challenging, we have already implemented the features you've been most excited about and will continue to introduce more thrilling content. Rest assured, releasing the full version does not mean we're abandoning the game; on the contrary, we're dedicated to continuously developing and improving it.

🌈 Looking forward to progressing with you in the future! 🌈

notes.title: June 6th v0.1.a6 update content
notes.notes:
[b]1. Recycle Gun Feature[/b]
Introducing the "Recycle Gun," available for purchase at convenience stores. It will automatically equip to your Tab quick-switch, allowing you to efficiently and quickly recycle any unwanted equipment, food stock, and decorations, saving you transportation time.

[b]2. Supermarket Restocking Search Function[/b]
The supermarket restocking interface now features a search function to help players quickly locate needed items. Intelligent tags and categorization features are postponed and expected in the next version.

[b]3. New Internet Café Equipment and Colors[/b]
We've added several new items to the internet café, including new desks, chairs, and computers, along with a new "Sky Blue" color scheme to add variety to your café's aesthetics!

[b]4. Neon Sign Style Upgrade[/b]
Added more than 30 new styles of decorative neon signs, larger in size and suitable for decorating entire walls, more vivid and attractive than before. We've also optimized the neon lights' night-time display effects to be more vibrant.

[b]5. Network Enhancement Service[/b]
Access the "Network Enhancement" website via personal computers to upgrade your shop's network speed. Customer reviews now include network speed ratings, so be sure to upgrade timely to avoid negative feedback!

[b]6. Casino Performance Optimization[/b]
We have optimized performance issues in the casino, ensuring that the game no longer faces performance drops when a large number of chips are added.

[b]7. Bug Fixes[/b]
We've fixed numerous bugs, including issues with unlocking the first achievement, supermarket restockers being immobile, customers stuck at checkout, robots jittering, and inaccessible second-hand recycling stations.

[b]8. Game Performance Enhancement[/b]
Further optimization has been made to ensure a smooth gaming experience.

[b]9. Interface and Detail Adjustments[/b]
We have optimized the game interface and other small details to enhance user experience.

[b]Thank You for Your Support[/b]
We sincerely appreciate the continued support and companionship of all our players, which drives our progress and improvements. We look forward to facing more updates and improvements together. Thank you once again for your love and support of our game!
